gloss: to rival; to be comparable to; to match

definitions.gloss: to rival; to be comparable to; to match
definitions.explanation: To be equal or comparable in quality, scale, or ability to something else. Typically used with に to indicate what is being matched.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}に{匹敵|ひってき}する{選手|せんしゅ}はいない。
examples.english: There is no player who can rival him.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}は{名作|めいさく}に{匹敵|ひってき}する{出来|でき}だ。
examples.english: This work is of a quality that rivals the masterpieces.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}の{人口|じんこう}に{匹敵|ひってき}する{規模|きぼ}の{都市|とし}は、{世界|せかい}でもそう{多|おお}くない。
examples.english: There are not many cities in the world on a scale comparable to Tokyo's population.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{匹敵|ひってき} is a する-verb that takes the particle に to mark what is being rivaled or matched. It implies the comparison is at a high level and carries a tone of respect or acknowledgment.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- AはBに{匹敵|ひってき}する (A rivals B / A is comparable to B)
- Bに{匹敵|ひってき}するA (A that rivals B)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力|じつりょく}に{匹敵|ひってき}する (rival in ability)
- プロに{匹敵|ひってき}する (comparable to a professional)
- {過去|かこ}の{記録|きろく}に{匹敵|ひってき}する (match past records)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対抗|たいこう}する emphasizes active competition or opposition
- {匹敵|ひってき}する emphasizes being on the same level, without implying direct conflict
